The Challenge

More Than a Booth.
A Brand Moment.

automotiveMastermind needed to deliver tangible value for attendees while strengthening the company's industry position at the most watched event on the automotive calendar. Attendees needed access to the latest industry trends, hands-on experience with upcoming product developments, and meaningful connections with engineers, experts, and peers from across the country.

The event had to balance technical education with relationship building, create a cohesive experience across multi-day programming, and facilitate meaningful interactions between company executives and key clients while establishing a scalable framework for future years. Most critically, the team needed to launch their rebrand as "automotive's trusted data and technology provider" at exactly the right moment, in exactly the right way, in front of exactly the right people.

About the Show

The Automotive Industry's
Event of the Year

The NADA Show is the world's largest automotive retail conference and expo, bringing together dealers, OEM executives, technology vendors, and allied industry professionals each year. It has been held in Las Vegas more times than anywhere else, drawing record numbers since NADA first held the show there in 1965. Securing a prominent presence at NADA is not just a marketing decision; it is a category-level statement.

2024 — Las Vegas, Feb. 1–4  ★ This Campaign
Driving the Future
  • 23,000+ automotive professionals in attendance
  • 500+ exhibitors across 3.2M sq ft of LVCC exhibit space

  • Revamped schedule: Main Stage sessions began at 9am daily

Data note: NADA does not officially publish total attendance figures. The 23,000 figure for 2024 is sourced from third-party show recaps and NADA's own day-by-day coverage, not an official NADA release. The 3.2 million square foot figure refers to the total available exhibit and function space at the Las Vegas Convention Center, not necessarily the full footprint used by NADA Show 2024 alone. All year-over-year figures sourced from NADA official communications, Trade Show Executive rankings, and exhibitor recap publications.

"Our logo could be seen from space."

automotiveMastermind secured the sponsorship of the NADA Welcome Party at the newly opened Las Vegas Sphere, featuring branding on the largest LED display on earth. A private Mastermind suite hosted customers through an immersive viewing of Darren Aronofsky's "Postcard from Earth" before the show floor even opened.

The Strategy

Four Pillars.
One Seamless Campaign.

The campaign combined pre-show momentum, a once-in-a-generation venue activation, a content-forward booth experience, and a coordinated media push across four integrated pillars.

01
Pre-Show Lead Generation
  • 88,000-prospect targeted email campaign
  • Dedicated NADA Demo Landing Page
  • GM-specific pipeline generation campaign targeting incentivized dealerships
  • Strategic direct mail to high-value prospects
02
Unprecedented Venue Sponsorship
  • NADA Welcome Party sponsorship at the Las Vegas Sphere
  • Private Mastermind suite for customer entertainment
  • Exterior branding visible across the Las Vegas skyline
  • Immersive "Postcard from Earth" screening by Darren Aronofsky
03
Content-Driven Booth Experience
  • Redesigned 50'×60' booth debuting new company positioning
  • Secured a prime show-floor location, positioned directly alongside parent company S&P Global Mobility
  • On-site content stage hosted by Wendy Engelhardt
  • 11 content stage interviews with customers, partners, and executives
  • 6 media interviews with tier-1 automotive publications
04
Strategic Media & Thought Leadership
  • 3 press releases timed to show milestones
  • Executive placement across Automotive News, CBT News, Wards Auto
  • Morgan Automotive Group partnership announcement
  • New integrations, data services, and open platform showcase

Project Management & Execution

Orchestrated Across
Six Months. Executed Flawlessly.

As Lead Project Manager, I owned end-to-end delivery of this multi-stakeholder event, managing every workstream from initial charter through post-event reporting.

🎯
Strategic Planning & Stakeholder Alignment
  • Developed comprehensive project charter and success metrics tied to business objectives
  • Facilitated cross-functional planning with Marketing, Sales, BD/SD, Product, and Executives
  • Built detailed project timeline with critical path analysis and dependency mapping
  • Established governance structure, weekly status cadence, and executive steering reviews
💰
Budget & Resource Management
  • Managed $850K+ show-specific budget across booth build, AV, SWAG, vendor coordination, and travel
  • Negotiated vendor contracts for Sphere sponsorship, booth fabrication, AV, and catering
  • Allocated resources across competing priorities to maximize ROI
  • Maintained variance reporting and real-time financial forecasting
🤝
Vendor & Logistics Coordination
  • Managed 15+ vendor relationships across venue, design, swag, and technology
  • Coordinated logistics for 50+ team members including travel and show floor schedules
  • Oversaw booth build timeline, shipping, and on-site installation
  • Secured all permits, insurance, and compliance documentation
📣
Marketing Campaign Integration
  • Aligned pre-show campaigns with event goals and lead generation targets
  • Coordinated timing across email, direct mail, social media, and press releases
  • Maintained brand consistency from Sphere exterior to booth collateral
  • Established UTM tracking and campaign attribution frameworks
🎤
Content & Programming Development
  • Designed content stage strategy and secured 11 interview participants
  • Coordinated media relations schedule for 6 tier-1 publication interviews
  • Managed speaker preparation, talking points, and executive briefing materials
  • Oversaw video production and post-event content distribution
⚠️
Risk Management & Reporting
  • Identified risks across technical, logistical, and reputational dimensions
  • Developed mitigation strategies and contingency plans for critical dependencies
  • Managed real-time issue resolution with dedicated war room operations on-site
  • Compiled post-event ROI analysis and presented findings to executive leadership

Looking Ahead

Future Recommendations
& Strategic Insight

  • Expand content-stage programming into year-round digital assets
  • Formalize a Sphere-level sponsorship playbook for signature activations
  • Scale pre-show pipeline campaigns for targeted OEM segments

Through rigorous project management and cross-functional coordination, this campaign transformed a trade show presence into a comprehensive brand relaunch that delivered immediate pipeline impact while establishing long-term market positioning.
